reason: Steel is a plausible material for a frame to support the mattress in the sheltered berth.
expectation: The steel and mattress will make a supported bed.

effect: Steel cannot be combined directly with the mattress; its listed partner is reflective insulation.
reaction: The failed bed-frame guess was mildly surprising.
reason: The failed attempt identified reflective insulation as a compatible partner for steel.
expectation: They will form an insulated structure for the sheltered berth.

effect: The steel and insulation made a raised, insulated berth frame, ready for the mattress.
reaction: The insulation under the deck makes the frame's purpose clear.
reason: The mattress fits the newly made berth frame.
expectation: The mattress will complete the sheltered berth.

effect: The mattress completed the cave berth and the chapter’s goal.
reaction: The boots under the raised frame and the empty growing room made the completed shelter feel lived-in but unfinished.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the insulated frame was most worthwhile: its raised deck and insulation explained how the berth avoids the cold floor.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to pair steel directly with the mattress was a small interruption; a frame seemed physically plausible, but the game required insulation first.

surprise.text: I was surprised that steel and the mattress could not combine directly, though the resulting insulated frame clarified the intended construction.

arbitrary.text: Requiring insulation before adding the mattress felt somewhat restrictive, even if the finished construction had a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would continue to see the growing room take shape; the practical shelter details and the glimpse of its empty floor suggest more useful making ahead.
